scope: Static G6 HJL matched-source follow-up only. No live router, QEMU firmware execution, setting changes or network calls. Older IJL/B9 request layouts not assumed equal.
supersedes: Inference that ics_set_default_* names imply persistent storage

queue.result_completion: 0x8d5f0 ->0x99198 writes4byte worker status to completion socket pair; callback0x90e84 ->0x99590 reads4bytes
queue.completion_socketpair: 0x99a00 socketpair(domain1,type5,protocol0); local Unix SOCK_SEQPACKET, not TCP or a named socket
queue.internal_timeout: No poll/select/timed wait in the inspected completion-reader function; outer D-Bus wrapper timeout15000ms is separate. End-to-end cancellation/FD policy not established.

request_fields.name: MAC string region before band; exact declaration/padding capacity not recovered
request_fields.encoding: NUL-terminated ASCII interpreted by strlen; conventional colon MAC; all-zero literal has special handling

request_fields.name: bandwidth
request_fields.encoding: little-endian32bit value; do not assume literal MHz

request_fields.name: reason
request_fields.encoding: little-endian32bit value; low8bits copied to internal configuration

separate_method_status: Worker return code is sent separately from the12byte result; payload validness must be judged with status, not any one zero field.
gates: Both pointers required; null path returns-2
All-zero colon MAC bypasses normal DB lookup
Nonzero MAC must resolve through0x81f00 and entry byte+0x184 must be nonzero; missing/offline paths reject
Invalid band selector rejects before ConfigurationMinder call

default_storage.finding: These exact setters update RAM object, with band-index helper and time getter only; no direct configuration-save/flash operation. This does not establish whole-request volatility or successful RF application.
